items.t: Head gasket failure linked to oil cooler and EGR cooler problems
items.job: Replace head gaskets with head studs, plus oil cooler and EGR cooler
items.note: If only the oil cooler and EGR cooler have failed (head gaskets still good), the bill is much lower.

items.t: Major engine failure or sudden power loss on the 6.4L diesel
items.job: Diagnose and repair major engine damage (up to engine replacement)
items.note: Wide range: many power-loss cases are fixed with fuel system or turbo repairs, while a full engine replacement sits at the top end.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump (CP4) failure
items.job: Replace high-pressure pump, injectors, fuel lines and clean the tank
items.note: Caught before debris spreads, only the pump may be needed and the cost is much lower.

items.t: Fuel injector failure on the 6.0L diesel
items.job: Replace fuel injectors (set of eight)
items.note: Replacing only the failed injectors costs less, but many shops recommend a full set.

items.t: Spark plug blown out of the cylinder head
items.job: Repair spark plug threads with an insert, new plug and coil
items.note: If the threads are too damaged for an insert, the cylinder head must be replaced and the cost rises a lot.

items.t: Turbocharger failure on early 6.7L diesels
items.job: Replace turbocharger

items.t: Radiator leaks at the end tanks on the 6.4L diesel
items.job: Replace radiator

items.t: Fuel thinning the engine oil during DPF cleaning
items.job: Extra oil and filter change (diesel)
items.note: A clogged DPF that needs removal and cleaning adds to the cost.

items.t: Fuel tank lining flakes and clogs the fuel filter
items.job: Replace fuel tank and fuel filters
items.note: If debris has reached the fuel pump or injectors, those repairs add a lot more.

items.t: Camshaft position sensor can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace camshaft position sensor (recall 07V553)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Speed control deactivation switch can overheat and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Install fused jumper harness for the speed control switch (recall 09V399)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Automatic transmission failure
items.job: Replace or rebuild automatic transmission

items.t: 4x4 front hubs won't lock or unlock
items.job: Replace front locking hub assemblies

items.t: Driveshaft damper can slip and break the driveshaft (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair rear driveshaft (recall 22V880)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Underbody insulator can wear through the aluminum driveshaft (recall)

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Fifth-wheel hitch bracket can crack (recall)

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Left rear axle shaft may break (recall)

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Rear driveshaft weld can fail (recall)

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Violent front-end shake ('death wobble')
items.job: Replace steering damper and worn front-end parts, adjust caster
items.note: Sometimes a caster adjustment or new damper is enough; worn track bar or ball joints add cost.

items.t: Fast or uneven front tire wear
items.job: Alignment and replace front tires

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: DEF tank heater or DEF system fault
items.job: Replace DEF tank heater / sending unit

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.
